purpose: Standalone host-side validation kit for a DUSRM 0.2-draft SAND OS architecture description.

validationContract.semanticChecker: DUSRM 0.2 semantic validator with operating-system profile coverage and maturity checks
osProfileRules: all required OS domains must be covered exactly once
internal domains must link to declared OS elements
applicable domains must link to declared evidence
testInSimulation and testOnHardware require context-appropriate evidence
all eight core DUSRM layers must appear in the many-to-many mapping
implemented maturity must agree with realizing element maturity
DUSRM must remain outside OS boot and runtime

limitations: This validates a DUSRM architecture description, not the SAND OS kernel binary or runtime.
Passing QEMU evidence remains emulator-scoped and is not physical hardware verification.
The OS profile remains not-assessed for compatibility.
The kit is experimental and must be independently reviewed before production CI adoption.
